description: This file defines the ActivationRepartitionerOptions class, which includes configuration settings for activation repartitioning in Orleans. It also contains a validator class that enforces constraints on the configuration values.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitionerOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for activation repartitioner, including edge count limits, timing, recovery, buffering, filtering, and error rate settings.

methods.name: ActivationRepartitionerOptionsValidator
methods.description: Validates the configuration options ensuring they meet specified constraints, throwing exceptions if invalid.
